SA-64
SUSPENSION AND AXLE ·- REAR SHOCK ABSORBER
INSPECTION
INSPECT SHOCK ABSORBER
Compress and extend the shock absorber rod and check that
there is no abnormal resistance or unusual sound during opera­
tion.
If there is any abnormality, replace the shock absorber witt a
new one.
NOTICE:
N When disposing of the shock absorber, see DISPOSAL on
page SA-65.
